# URL edge cases: the contract for finding and repairing URLs (PRD §4.1–4.3, §9).
#
# One case per line:   <input> ⇒ <expected>
# <expected> is every URL found, as stored in Link.url (after repair), separated
# by spaces, or ∅ when nothing should be stored. \u{XXXX} in an input stands
# for that character, so invisible ones stay readable. Lines starting with #
# are comments.

## Plain matches
https://example.com ⇒ https://example.com
http://example.com/path ⇒ http://example.com/path
HTTPS://Example.COM/Path ⇒ HTTPS://Example.COM/Path
https://example.com/path/ ⇒ https://example.com/path/
two links https://a.example.com/1 and https://b.example.com/2 ⇒ https://a.example.com/1 https://b.example.com/2

## www. without a scheme gets https://
www.example.com/guide ⇒ https://www.example.com/guide
See also www.example.com/guide. ⇒ https://www.example.com/guide
(www.example.com) ⇒ https://www.example.com

## Bare domains: found, with https:// added, when the ending is a real one (§4.1)
example.com/foo ⇒ https://example.com/foo
visit example.co.uk today ⇒ https://example.co.uk
try codesandbox.io ⇒ https://codesandbox.io
Visit codesandbox.io. ⇒ https://codesandbox.io
see notion.so and v0.dev ⇒ https://notion.so https://v0.dev
GitHub.com ⇒ https://GitHub.com
teamspeak.redjex.com ⇒ https://teamspeak.redjex.com
(see github.com/org/repo) ⇒ https://github.com/org/repo
github.com/org/repo. ⇒ https://github.com/org/repo
allegro.pl/oferta/123 ⇒ https://allegro.pl/oferta/123

## Bare-looking text that isn't a domain: code, file names, emails, abbreviations
console.log(x) ⇒ ∅
next.js is great ⇒ ∅
const u = request.url; ⇒ ∅
read design.md first ⇒ ∅
run setup.sh ⇒ ∅
python main.py ⇒ ∅
unzip archive.zip ⇒ ∅
clip.mov ⇒ ∅
user.name and item.id ⇒ ∅
version v1.2.3 ⇒ ∅
e.g. this, i.e. that ⇒ ∅
someone@example.com ⇒ ∅
jane.design@studio.com ⇒ ∅
/usr/local/bin/setup.sh ⇒ ∅
./src/app.ts ⇒ ∅
mr.bean ⇒ ∅

## Glued to the word before it
link:https://example.com/glued ⇒ https://example.com/glued
Checkhttps://example.com/glued ⇒ https://example.com/glued

## Trailing punctuation
Read https://example.com/a. ⇒ https://example.com/a
https://example.com/a, then ⇒ https://example.com/a
https://example.com/a; next ⇒ https://example.com/a
https://example.com/a: note ⇒ https://example.com/a
wow https://example.com/a! ⇒ https://example.com/a
Is it https://example.com/is-it? not sure ⇒ https://example.com/is-it
https://example.com/a... ⇒ https://example.com/a
See https://example.com/guide/getting-started. Then the API page ⇒ https://example.com/guide/getting-started
https://example.com/a-long-pa… ⇒ https://example.com/a-long-pa

## Quotes and brackets
"https://example.com/quoted" ⇒ https://example.com/quoted
'https://example.com/single' ⇒ https://example.com/single
(see https://x.com/a) ⇒ https://x.com/a
https://example.com/a). ⇒ https://example.com/a
[https://example.com/b] ⇒ https://example.com/b
{https://example.com/c} ⇒ https://example.com/c
<https://example.com/angle> ⇒ https://example.com/angle
> https://example.com/reply ⇒ https://example.com/reply
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar) ⇒ https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar)
(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar)) ⇒ https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schindler's_List ⇒ https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schindler's_List

## Markdown written as plain text
[React docs](https://react.dev/learn) — start here ⇒ https://react.dev/learn
![alt](https://example.com/img.png) ⇒ https://example.com/img.png

## Emphasis: stripped only when the same mark opens the URL
*https://example.com/bold* ⇒ https://example.com/bold
**https://example.com/bold2** ⇒ https://example.com/bold2
_https://example.com/italic_ ⇒ https://example.com/italic
~https://example.com/strike~ ⇒ https://example.com/strike
https://youtu.be/ZyXwVuTsRqP?si=Ab12_cd34efgh5_ ⇒ https://youtu.be/ZyXwVuTsRqP?si=Ab12_cd34efgh5_

## Invisible characters end a URL
https://example.com/lrm\u{200E} ⇒ https://example.com/lrm
\u{200E}https://example.com/lrm-before ⇒ https://example.com/lrm-before
https://example.com/zwsp\u{200B}tail ⇒ https://example.com/zwsp
\u{FEFF}https://example.com/bom ⇒ https://example.com/bom
https://example.com/nbsp\u{00A0}next ⇒ https://example.com/nbsp
https://example.com/nnbsp\u{202F}PM ⇒ https://example.com/nnbsp
👨\u{200D}💻 https://example.dev/tools ⇒ https://example.dev/tools

## Emoji end a URL
https://example.com/funny😂😂 ⇒ https://example.com/funny
https://example.com/a👍\u{FE0F} ⇒ https://example.com/a

## CJK punctuation ends a URL; Unicode paths are kept
リンク：https://example.jp/page、次 ⇒ https://example.jp/page
「https://example.jp/quote」 ⇒ https://example.jp/quote
（https://example.jp/paren） ⇒ https://example.jp/paren
https://example.jp/page。 ⇒ https://example.jp/page
https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/東京 ⇒ https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/東京

## Hosts
https://localhost:3000/dev ⇒ https://localhost:3000/dev
http://192.168.1.10:8080/admin ⇒ http://192.168.1.10:8080/admin
http://[::1]:3000/ ⇒ http://[::1]:3000/
https://user:pass@example.com/secret ⇒ https://user:pass@example.com/secret
https://example ⇒ ∅
https://. ⇒ ∅

## Not web links (counted as skipped, never stored)
mail me at mailto:someone@example.com ⇒ ∅
call tel:+441632960123 ⇒ ∅
whatsapp://send?text=hi ⇒ ∅
javascript:alert(1) ⇒ ∅

## Code: template placeholders are not links
const url = `https://api.example.com/users/${userId}`; ⇒ ∅
https://example.com/{{slug}} ⇒ ∅

## Fragments and queries are kept as found
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/abc123/edit#slide=id.p (needs access) ⇒ https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/abc123/edit#slide=id.p
https://app.example/#/inbox ⇒ https://app.example/#/inbox
https://shop.example.com/search?q=oak,shelf&colour=light%20brown&utm_source=newsletter ⇒ https://shop.example.com/search?q=oak,shelf&colour=light%20brown&utm_source=newsletter

## Escaped inside JSON or HTML: found, and stored decoded (§4.1)
{"text": "look https:\/\/example.com\/a?b=1\u0026c=2"} ⇒ https://example.com/a?b=1&c=2
"url":"https:\/\/x.com\/i\/status\/123" ⇒ https://x.com/i/status/123
{"link": "https:\u002F\u002Fexample.com\u002Fpath"} ⇒ https://example.com/path
{"t":"https:\/\/example.com\/caf\u00e9"} ⇒ https://example.com/café
"www.example.com\/guide" ⇒ https://www.example.com/guide
"see https:\/\/example.com\/a\nnext line" ⇒ https://example.com/a
"https:\/\/example.com\/a\\b" ⇒ https://example.com/a
"https:\/\/example.com\/q?x=\"quoted\"" ⇒ https://example.com/q?x=
<a href="https://example.com/?a=1&amp;b=2">x</a> ⇒ https://example.com/?a=1&b=2
<a href="https://example.com/p?q=a&#38;r=b"> ⇒ https://example.com/p?q=a&r=b
<a href='https://example.com/x&#x26;y'> ⇒ https://example.com/x&y
https://example.com/?a=1&amp; ⇒ https://example.com/?a=1&
Tom &amp; Jerry https://example.com/tj ⇒ https://example.com/tj
